[LGRA.4.6] **A constant's bare name is bound once.** The compiler must reject,
with `DS_VALIDATE_IMPORT_NAME_COLLISION`, a program that brings two distinct
constants into bare scope under one NFC name:

- a local `const` whose name a selective import ([LIMP.4.2.4]) binds to a
  library's constant;
- two selective imports that bind one name to constants of different
  libraries.

One constant reached by two import paths is one constant, and no collision. A
qualified import binds no bare name ([LGRA.22.9]), so `ha.LIMIT` beside a local
`LIMIT` is none either. The author renames the local declaration, or renames
the import with `as` ([LIMP.2.1.7]).

Two other cases have their own homes: two local declarations of one name are
[LGRA.4.3]'s, and a local constant named for a member of a library that
carries builtins ([LIMP.3.3.4]), imported bare, is [LGRA.22.9]'s, refused with
`DS_VALIDATE_BINDING_SHADOWS_LIBRARY`.
